en: willing to take risks and try new ideas; enjoying being in new, exciting situations
a woman who enjoys exciting new experiences, especially going to unusual places
the fact of being willing to take risks in business or politics in order to gain something for yourself
ex: He condemned what he saw as undisciplined adventurism.
他谴责自己认为是无纪律的冒险主义。

zh: 有冒险精神的；大胆开拓的
充满新鲜事物的；刺激不断的；惊险的
en: willing to take risks and try new ideas; enjoying being in new, exciting situations
ex: For the more adventurous tourists, there are trips into the mountains with a local guide.
对更愿猎奇探险的旅游者，有本地向导带领进山游览。

zh: 有冒险精神的；大胆开拓的
en: in a way that shows you are willing to take risks; showing pleasure in being in new, exciting situations
ex: She made her home in Rome and travelled adventurously in north Africa.
她在罗马回家，并在北非冒险旅行。

en: a word that adds more information about place, time, manner, cause or degree to a verb, an adjective, a phrase or another adverb
ex: In ‘speak kindly’, ‘incredibly deep’, ‘just in time’ and ‘too quickly’, ‘kindly’, ‘incredibly’, ‘just’ and ‘too’ are all adverbs.
在 speak kindly、incredibly deep、just in time 和 too quickly 四个短语中，kindly、incredibly、just 和 too 都是副词。

en: adding more information about place, time, manner, cause or degree to a verb, an adjective, a phrase or another adverb
ex: ‘Very quickly indeed’ is an adverbial phrase.
very quickly indeed 是副词短语。

zh: 副词小词，副词小品词（尤用于动词后，表示位置、运动方向等）
en: an adverb used especially after a verb to show position, direction of movement, etc.
ex: In ‘come back’, ‘break down’ and ‘fall off’, ‘back’, ‘down’ and ‘off’ are all adverbial particles.
在 come back、break down 和 fall off 中，back、down 和 off 都是副词小词。

en: involving people who are in opposition and who argue against each other
ex: the adversarial nature of the two-party system
两党制的对抗本质

en: a person that somebody is opposed to and competing with in an argument or a battle
ex: his old political adversary
他的老政治对手
